scope: fixed B20 selected callbacks, one cash equity market buy, no OHLC synthesis
order_input: Original 12:00 request and quantity; native reservation uses then-observed JQ-source current last
matching_price: Exact TDX source point price at the pulse; not certified as executable quote or minute close
capacity: Native matcher receives source point volume_lots times 100 shares, ratio 1; source precision one lot; interval semantics unverified
lunch_policy: No matching at 12:00, 12:59 or 13:00; retain native order until the first explicitly bound point
status_and_limits: Conditional continuation of the observed 12:00 JQ-source security status and daily limits within this bounded window; not new market facts
valuation: After the matching pulse and at 15:00 update native position marks from exact point price; before first point retain observed 12:00 mark; 15:30 uses AD final daily valuation
single_account_owner: RQAlpha native broker, matcher, portfolio and account
matching_phase: After the 13:01 user callback; native point-price valuation refresh before callback, native matching after callback at the same logical time
